items.title: My Community My University: How Community-Based Research Stopped a Coal Power Plant in Myanmar
items.description: Part of a three-article series on people who used community-based research tools. I interviewed and profiled Mi Tri, an activist and community-based researcher from Mon State, Myanmar, about the tools and strategies she used against a large-scale development project that threatened her community's environment.

items.title: Drawing the River Under Surveillance: How Communities in Laos Protect Their Rights and Natural Resources
items.description: Interviewed and profiled a Lao lawyer and community rights defender on how he works directly with communities, the tools he uses, and the challenges he has faced.

items.title: Bringing Out Community Knowledge: LEAD Lessons from the Mekong
items.description: Blog post and briefer on community-led research methods in the Mekong region. Compiled and analysed insights from multi-country training sessions into accessible content on participatory approaches and centring local knowledge in human rights work.

items.title: Six Harvests of Campaigning for an End to Coal Mining in Omkoi
items.description: Social media and blog post announcing the achievements, history and future hopes of the six-year campaign.

items.title: Juvie, using documentation as a tool against injustice
items.description: Interviewed a human rights defender from the Philippines on her experience and outlook. Published as a social media campaign and blog post.

items.title: From Africa to Europe: Enhancing global collaborations to protect human rights defenders at risk
items.description: Documented an international convening on protecting at-risk human rights defenders.

items.title: The beginning of a partnership between Ubuntu Hub Cities and Shelter City
items.description: Announced the collaboration between Shelter City and Ubuntu Hub Cities to expand the temporary relocation network for at-risk African human rights defenders.

items.title: Facilitating Community-Led Research in Challenging Contexts
items.description: Wrote the contents of the report and collaborated on the design and layout.

items.title: Welcome Guide NL
items.description: A guide to the Netherlands for new Shelter City guests. I designed, compiled and edited the document.

items.title: Welcome Booklet, Global Partner Meeting
items.description: Produced for over 70 participants at the Shelter City Global Partner Meeting.

items.title: A Guide to The Hague
items.description: A plain-language guide to The Hague for new HRD guests hosted in the city and for participants of the Global Partner Meeting.

items.title: Bi-yearly Reflection Report
items.description: Designed the report in line with branding, wrote the contents, and led the evaluation of different projects.
